meta.description: A thin skin that hangs from one attachment with a ragged edge, like the ring a torn veil leaves on the stipe or the fringe it leaves on the cap margin. Around a point on a path it hangs from the path all around; from a ring of points, like a margin, it hangs on the inside, along the points and out of the flesh of the paths they sit on. Gives the skin as a thin sheet mesh, which stays sharp at any mesh resolution.

attachment.description: Where the skin hangs from. A point on a path, e.g. from points_on_path on the stipe: the skin goes around the path there, at its thickness and across its tangent. A ring of points, e.g. a cap margin: the skin hangs from the ring, starting inside the round end of the paths the points sit on (as thick as their scale). Only points at the tips of their paths make a ring, so the points on the stipes of a cluster get a skin each.

length.description: How long the skin hangs, from where it is attached to its torn edge. The seed makes the edge wander around it. 0 = no skin. On a ring it is read at every point, alpha around the ring: a random gives flaps of different length, 0 leaves a gap.

flare.description: How the skin hangs, read along it from where it is attached (alpha 0) to its edge (1): 0 = straight down, 1 = straight out, away from a path or in from a ring. A curve node into it shapes the skin. On a ring it is read at every point, a random into the curve lets every flap hang its own way.

thickness.description: Thickness of the skin, it thins towards its edge

resolution_curve.description: Points along a strand from where the skin is attached to its edge
